noun_definition: Setting refers to a configurable option within the application that allows users to manage their notification preferences.
Notification preference refers to the setting that allows users to choose whether they want to be notified about new messages in a specific chat room.
who refers to the setting that determines the permissions for users to post messages in the notification preferences of the application.
post refers to the action of sending a message in a designated communication channel, specifically within the context of a workspace's announcement room.
